prompt: Review index.mjs against this contract: exact lookup uses only io.exact(id), never falls back to scanning on a miss, and filters session. List query uses io.recent(sessionId, limit), never io.scanAll, preserving returned order and limit. io.recent is a bounded session index; scanAll traverses unbounded history and may be prohibitively expensive. Existing focused tests are not exhaustive. Return only JSON {"findings":[{"path":"source filename","startLine":1,"endLine":1,"quote":"verbatim source span, at most 500 characters","severity":"critical|high|medium|low","explanation":"failure and consequence","repair":{"oldText":"unique source span","newText":"suggested replacement"}}]}. No edits. Include only material defects (empty findings if none). Severity: critical = unsafe duplicate side effects or concurrent same-key mutation; high = unbounded resource use, wrong completion acceptance, or rejected valid completion; medium = malformed input mishandling; low = cosmetic. Suggest narrowly scoped executable repairs, not an entire rewritten file; advice is tested host-side against focused and unseen regressions. No extra fields or prose.
